origin.description: Replace the rightmost literal match in each string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: Text that replaces the match. NA makes a matched string missing.

origin.details: The match is the rightmost one, so a later overlapping occurrence wins. No match returns the original string. An empty string stays empty. An empty pattern or a missing string or pattern yields NA. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
origin.example:
found <- stri_replace_last_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive = TRUE)
cat(paste0('stri_replace_last_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive=TRUE) returns ', found, '.\n'))

translation.description: Replace the rightmost literal match in each string.
translation.usage: stri_replace_last_fixed(str, pattern, replacement, opts_fixed=None, case_insensitive=None, overlap=None)

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Literal pattern, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: Text that replaces the match. NA makes a matched string missing.

arguments.name: opts_fixed
arguments.text: None, or a dict of search settings. Overlap is ignored.

arguments.name: case_insensitive
arguments.text: If given, match the simple uppercase of each code point.

arguments.name: overlap
arguments.text: Ignored. The replaced match is the rightmost one.

translation.details: The match is the rightmost one, so a later overlapping occurrence wins. No match returns the original string. An empty string stays empty. An empty pattern or a missing string or pattern yields NA. A missing opts_fixed uses case-sensitive search without overlap. A dict may set case_insensitive and overlap. Case-insensitive search maps each code point with ICU u_toupper. A character whose uppercase form is longer than one code point is left unchanged, so ß does not match SS.
translation.value: A list of strings and NA.
translation.example:
from stringi.fixed import stri_replace_last_fixed
found = stri_replace_last_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive=True)
print(f'stri_replace_last_fixed("aAaA", "a", "X", case_insensitive=True) returns {found[0]}.')
